sql: select cls, floor(fish_date_doy/10)*10 b, round(sum(yt)/sum(anglers),2) r, count(*) n from trips where fish_date_season=1 and fish_date_doy>=150 group by 1,2 having sum(anglers)>0 and cls in ('three_quarter','overnight','day_1_5','multi_day') order by 1,2

summary: Long-range booking now gates each class on its own 7-day rate and ranks by fish per dollar (fixes hot 1.5-day triggering a dead overnight).
